cards.card_text: At the north gate of the house of the LORD, Ezekiel sees ___ sitting there, weeping for Tammuz, a false god.
cards.verse_text: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.
